questions: Did this episode begin suddenly with a loss of awareness or responsiveness?
Did the patient stiffen or have rhythmic jerking of the arms or legs?
Were the eyes deviated or rolled upward during the episode?
Did the patient bite their tongue or lose bladder or bowel control?
Was the patient confused, unusually sleepy, or difficult to awaken afterward?
Has the patient had a similar episode before?
Did the patient sustain a head injury immediately before this episode?
Did the patient have a fever or recent illness?
Could the patient have taken an overdose or been exposed to alcohol or recreational drugs?
Does the patient have diabetes or take medication that can lower blood sugar?
Is the patient currently pregnant or recently postpartum?
Is the patient still having trouble breathing or remaining unresponsive?
